CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Overview

nlmixr2save saves ‘nlmixr2’ fits in a portable format (a .zip of CSV files plus deparsed R scripts and a loader script) that can be read outside nlmixr2 and independently of the package version. It also provides the := caching operator, which saves the result of an expensive fit or simulation to disk and reloads it when the inputs have not changed. The package is mostly R (R/save.R) with one small Rcpp helper in src/.

Imports: checkmate, cli, digest, Rcpp, rxode2, zip. nlmixr2est, nlmixr2data, data.table, withr, babelmixr2, PopED, tidyvpc, dplyr are Suggests only – guard their use with requireNamespace() / skip_if_not_installed().

Build and Development Commands

Install / Document

devtools::document()
devtools::install()
# or from the shell: R CMD INSTALL .

After changing the // [[Rcpp::export]] function in src/nlmixr2fix.cpp (or its arguments), run Rcpp::compileAttributes(".") to regenerate src/RcppExports.cpp and R/RcppExports.R; registration is automatic (useDynLib(nlmixr2save, .registration = TRUE)), there is no manual init.c.

Run All Tests

NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e "devtools::test()"

Run a Single Test File

NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e "devtools::test(filter='save')"
NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e "devtools::test(filter='simplify')"

Many tests fit real models and need nlmixr2est and nlmixr2data installed; they skip otherwise.

R CMD Check

devtools::check()
# Or: R CMD build . && R CMD check nlmixr2save_*.tar.gz

Architecture

Saving and loading fits (R/save.R)

  • saveFit() is an S3 generic (saveFit.nlmixr2FitCore, saveFit.nlmixr2FitData, saveFit.default which errors). Each fit item is written by the saveFitItem() S3 generic (methods for rxUi, data.frame, saemFit, foceiModelList, saemModelList, nlmixr2estSessionInfo, default). Data frames go to CSV; other objects are deparsed to R code (.saveDeparse()).
  • Files are named <file>-<item>..., plus a <file>-env.R and a loader script <file>.R generated by .nlmixr2saveLoaderText(). The loader restores the fit; items in .saveFitEnv$lazy (foceiModel, saemModel, ui) are built on first use with delayedAssign().
  • saveFit() writes every file into a private temporary directory (.nlmixr2saveFitStaged()) and then zips (or with zip=FALSE copies) only those files. Never select files in the target directory by a name pattern such as <file>-*: - is legal in a base name, so this would sweep in another fit’s files (NEWS 0.2.1, #10).
  • file may include a directory; files inside the archive always use the bare base name so the .zip can be moved and loaded from anywhere.
  • loadFit() accepts a base name, a bare symbol, or a .zip/.R path. Archives are extracted flat into a temporary directory, never the working directory. Loaders from older versions that reference a saved path are detected and regenerated (.nlmixr2saveLoaderUsable(), .nlmixr2saveFindLoader()). Keep loading of fits saved by earlier versions working.
  • Version metadata (nlmixr2est/rxode2 versions and remote sha) is stored with a fit; loadFit() warns on mismatch unless nlmixr2save.checkVersion is FALSE.
  • Type restoration after the CSV round-trip: .nlmixr2saveRestoreIdFactor(), .nlmixr2saveRestoreIniDf0(), .nlmixr2saveRestoreParHistType(), and the C++ nlmixr2saveParFixedDf() (src/nlmixr2fix.cpp), which restores numeric parFixedDf columns as named or unnamed vectors depending on the nlmixr2est version that produced the fit.
  • nlmixr2saveShare() writes <name>-noData.zip (or <name>-noData-noFit.zip with noFit=TRUE) without the original data.

The := cache operator (R/save.R)

  • := is an exported S3 generic; methods include :=.default, :=.nlmixr2FitCore, and the assign_* classes (assign_nlmixr, assign_nlmixr2, assign_nlmixr2FitData, assign_default).
  • Fits are cached as <prefix><name>.zip; other values as <prefix><name>.rds holding the value and a sha1 digest of the call arguments (.digest(), using the digest package). A mismatched digest removes the cache and re-runs.
  • Functions in the random registry (saveFitRandom(); defaults rxSolve, simulate, sim, mrgsim, predict, vpcSim) also store the rxode2 RNG seed before and after, and restore it on reload so the random state matches a real run.
  • .nlmixr2saveProps() (exported, internal) computes the properties of an nlmixr2 call used for the cache key, including the simplified data from nlmixrDataSimplify() (R/simplify.R).
  • nlmixr2saveInvalidate() deletes cache files matching the current prefix in the current cache directory.

Options

Option Default Effect
nlmixr2save.quiet FALSE suppress cli info messages (.minfo())
nlmixr2save.dir "." directory for := cache files
nlmixr2save.prefix "" prefix for cache file names; may name a subdirectory
nlmixr2save.check TRUE FALSE trusts an existing cache without checking inputs
nlmixr2save.checkVersion TRUE warn on nlmixr2est/rxode2 version mismatch at load
nlmixr2save.data TRUE default for saveFit(data=)

data.table attach hook (R/zzz.R)

data.table exports its own :=, which masks nlmixr2save’s when data.table is attached later. .onLoad registers a single packageEvent("data.table", "attach") hook that re-attaches nlmixr2save in front of data.table (.nlmixr2saveReattach()), respecting include.only and strict conflicts.policy. Tests in tests/testthat/test-datatable.R run in a child R session and only run against the installed build.

Important Files

File Purpose
R/save.R saveFit, loadFit, saveFitItem, :=, cache, share, options
R/simplify.R nlmixrDataSimplify() for cache-key data
R/zzz.R .onLoad and the data.table re-attach hook
src/nlmixr2fix.cpp nlmixr2saveParFixedDf() Rcpp helper
src/RcppExports.cpp, R/RcppExports.R generated by Rcpp::compileAttributes()
vignettes/*.Rmd uses, sharing fits, models directory, version tracking, registering simulation functions

Testing Conventions

  • testthat edition 3; files are tests/testthat/test-*.R.
  • tests/testthat.R caps rxode2/OpenMP threads to 1 when NOT_CRAN is not "true" (avoids the CRAN “CPU time > elapsed time” NOTE). Keep it.
  • Tests set options(nlmixr2save.quiet = TRUE); write files inside withr::with_tempdir() (or withr::local_*) so nothing is left in the test directory.
  • Use skip_if_not_installed() for any Suggests package and skip_on_cran() for slow or child-process tests.
  • tests/testthat/helper-fitfiles.R lists the loose files of a fake fit written by hand in tests.

Code Style

  • Exported functions: camelCase (saveFit, loadFit, nlmixr2saveShare). Internal functions and local variables: leading dot .camelCase (.nlmixr2saveBase, .ret). S3 methods: generic.class.
  • Validate arguments with checkmate; report errors with stop(..., call.=FALSE) and info messages through .minfo().
  • Do not use pkg:::fun; tests run in the package namespace and can call internals by bare name.
  • Document exported functions with roxygen (@param, @return, @export); examples that fit models go in \donttest{} guarded by requireNamespace() and run in withr::with_tempdir().
  • NEWS.md is organized per version (# nlmixr2save X.Y.Z) with past-tense bullets describing the user-visible effect.
  • ASCII only in R, C++, tests, docs, vignettes, and NEWS (CRAN requirement): use --, ->, straight quotes, ....

Release / CRAN Cautions

  • The package is on CRAN; cran-comments.md records submission notes.
  • Saved archives are an on-disk format: changes to file names, the loader script, or item encoding must still load fits written by earlier versions.
  • Do not write into the user’s working directory or home directory from examples, tests, or vignettes; use a temporary directory.
  • CI: .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml (macOS, Windows, Ubuntu devel/release/oldrel-1, installing nlmixr2 dependencies from GitHub), test-coverage.yaml, pkgdown.yaml.

CRAN tests: never assert on timing

  • Never put a wall-clock timing expectation in a test that can run on CRAN: no expect_lt()/expect_true() on Sys.time() differences, system.time(), proc.time(), bench/microbenchmark results, or any other elapsed-time threshold. CRAN check machines are shared and heavily loaded, so elapsed time there is random and a timing assertion fails at random. Example: nlmixr2plot test-model-diagram.R asserted a modelGraph() call took < 30 s; on CRAN it took 48.4 s and failed.
  • Test the result, not the speed. If a speed regression guard is really needed, put it only in a test that starts with skip_on_cran() (or the package’s own CRAN skip helper), and never in examples or vignettes.
  • Tests that take more than a few seconds should also skip on CRAN.
